== Summary ==
Logo of the [[Players Committee]]: the oval ''SWCCG Player's Committee'' emblem used as the banner logo of the committee's first website, swccgpc.com, from at least November 2002 to at least April 2006.
* '''Source:''' [https://web.archive.org/web/20021106101746im_/http://swccgpc.com/image/mainlogo.gif swccgpc.com/image/mainlogo.gif] on the [https://web.archive.org/web/20021106101746/http://swccgpc.com/ swccgpc.com home page] (Internet Archive capture of 6 November 2002; retrieved 10 October 2026).
* '''Processing:''' converted from GIF to PNG, otherwise unchanged. A smaller printing of the same oval is [[:File:PC logo former.png]].

== Licensing ==
Logo of the Players Committee, shown for identification in the article [[Players Committee]]. Rights remain with their owners.
